name: Killing Flourish
prerequisites: Intimidating Prowess, Intimidate 4 ranks, slayer level 4th
benefit:
When you reduce your target to below 0 hit points with a melee attack, as a swift action you can attempt an Intimidate check to demoralize all foes within 30 feet who can see your attack.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 125
When you confirm a critical hit, you can spend 5 stamina points and take a swift action to attempt an Intimidate check to demoralize all foes within 30 feet who can see your attack.
flavor: You inspire dread in other foes when you slay an enemy.
